description: This header defines the CycleClock class and related functions for accessing a cycle counter with approximately constant rate, including methods to get current cycle count and frequency, and to register alternate sources.

classes.name: CycleClock
classes.description: Provides static methods to access cycle counter value and frequency, and to load cycle clock source.

classes.name: CycleClockSource
classes.description: Allows registration of an alternate source function for the cycle counter.

methods.name: CycleClock::Now
methods.description: Returns the current value of the cycle counter.

methods.name: CycleClock::Frequency
methods.description: Returns the frequency at which the cycle counter increments.

methods.name: CycleClockSource::Register
methods.description: Registers an alternate source function for the cycle counter.
